evidence.title: French minister invites UK to ‘come all the way back’ to the EU

occurrences.checkable_against: UK prime minister's official itinerary and German government statements
occurrences.quote_span: The prime minister is travelling to Germany for talks with the chancellor, Friedrich Merz, whose government has been supportive of Burnham’s suggestion that the UK could explore closer links with the EU.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: UK-Germany talks on security cooperation and UK-EU relations

evidence.title: Burnham to meet German chancellor in Berlin to discuss security and EU ties

occurrences.checkable_against: UK and German intelligence assessments on North Sea undersea cable mapping
occurrences.quote_span: We know Russia has been mapping undersea cables in the North Sea; that's something I'm sure Andy Burnham will be talking to Chancellor Merz about because it affects both the UK and Germany," he added.
occurrences.speaker: Sir Mark Lyall Grant
occurrences.subject: UK-Germany talks on security cooperation and UK-EU relations

occurrences.checkable_against: Andy Burnham's pre-visit statement or transcript
occurrences.quote_span:
"Attacks on our infrastructure, our businesses and our democracies are not a distant threat.
"They reach into people's homes and workplaces, and they are designed to make us weaker and more divided."
occurrences.speaker: Andy Burnham
occurrences.subject: UK-Germany talks on security cooperation and UK-EU relations

occurrences.checkable_against: German Chancellery official programme
occurrences.quote_span: Burnham is set to be greeted with military honours at the German capital's Chancellery ahead of his first face-to-face meeting with the chancellor.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: UK-Germany talks on security cooperation and UK-EU relations

occurrences.checkable_against: Andy Burnham's pre-visit statement or transcript
occurrences.quote_span: Speaking ahead of the visit, Burnham said the UK and Germany were "joining forces to find, expose and disrupt" threats.
occurrences.speaker: Andy Burnham
occurrences.subject: UK-Germany talks on security cooperation and UK-EU relations

occurrences.checkable_against: UK Prime Minister's Office and German Chancellery visit schedules
occurrences.quote_span: Andy Burnham will hold talks on tackling cyber-security threats and sabotage with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz later.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: UK-Germany talks on security cooperation and UK-EU relations

occurrences.checkable_against: German government press briefing transcript
occurrences.quote_span: A German government spokesman has said any future in-out referendum would be primarily a question for Britain, but that Berlin supports stronger ties between the UK and the EU.
occurrences.speaker: German government spokesman
occurrences.subject: UK-Germany talks on security cooperation and UK-EU relations

occurrences.checkable_against: European leaders' public statements and intelligence assessments
occurrences.quote_span: European leaders have warned the threat of hybrid attacks against Europe by Russia has intensified in recent weeks.
occurrences.speaker: European leaders
occurrences.subject: UK-Germany talks on security cooperation and UK-EU relations

occurrences.checkable_against: Radio 4 Today interview transcript with Sir Mark Lyall Grant
occurrences.quote_span: Sir Mark Lyall Grant, former UK national security adviser, explained that hybrid warfare "falls somewhere between peace and war - it's in that sort of grey zone, an area where Russia has been extremely active for some time".
occurrences.speaker: Sir Mark Lyall Grant
occurrences.subject: UK-Germany talks on security cooperation and UK-EU relations

occurrences.checkable_against: UK Foreign Office statements and UK-Germany cooperation agreements
occurrences.quote_span: "We're going to be seeing new partnerships between German space companies and our Spaceport in Scotland; we're going to be ensuring research and technical capability between our top researchers working on quantum technologies which are going to change the world of computing."
occurrences.speaker: Stephen Doughty
occurrences.subject: UK-Germany talks on security cooperation and UK-EU relations

occurrences.checkable_against: 2025 Kensington Treaty and UK-Germany ratification record
occurrences.quote_span: On Thursday, the two leaders will formally ratify the 2025 Kensington Treaty, a partnership committing both countries to tackle hostile activity through deeper cooperation on science, technology, defence, security and growth.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: UK-Germany talks on security cooperation and UK-EU relations

occurrences.checkable_against: German government press briefing transcript
occurrences.quote_span: A German government spokesman has said any future in-out referendum would be primarily a question for Britain, but that Berlin supports stronger ties between the UK and the EU.
occurrences.speaker: German government spokesman
occurrences.subject: UK-Germany talks on security cooperation and UK-EU relations

occurrences.checkable_against: Radio 4 Today interview transcript and UK national security assessments
occurrences.quote_span: He told Radio 4's Today that while Russia had posed a threat to the UK since Vladimir Putin became president in 2001, there had been an "intensification" in response to European support for Ukraine following Russia's invasion.
occurrences.speaker: Sir Mark Lyall Grant
occurrences.subject: UK-Germany talks on security cooperation and UK-EU relations

occurrences.checkable_against: Downing Street briefing or official visit agenda
occurrences.quote_span: Downing Street said deeper co-operation in the face of rising hybrid threats from Russia would be high on the agenda during Burnham's first official visit to Germany.
occurrences.speaker: Downing Street
occurrences.subject: UK-Germany talks on security cooperation and UK-EU relations
